name: Avalanche Card International
summary: A crypto-powered credit card designed for international users, particularly in LATAM and the Caribbean, featuring self-custody and global Visa acceptance.

faq.question: Does the Avalanche Card International charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Avalanche Card International?
faq.answer: It charges about 2% on non-base-currency spending.
